nodes.label: Red Bull Wololo: Londinium
nodes.description: 8th edition of the premier AoE esports series. Held across 3 iconic London venues, Apr 1–6 2026. $250k prize pool.

nodes.label: AoE2 Main Event
nodes.description: 8-player Empire Wars bracket. $170k prize pool. Bo5 groups → Bo7 playoffs → Bo9 Grand Final.

nodes.label: AoE4 Main Event
nodes.description: 4-player single-elimination bracket. $40k prize pool. All series Bo5.

nodes.label: AoE2 Replacement Qualifier
nodes.description: Emergency 3-player round-robin on Mar 28, 4 days before groups. Triggered by Vinchester's visa denial.

nodes.label: Road to Wololo: Londinium
nodes.description: AoE4 qualification circuit. Jan–Feb 2026. $50k total pool, $10k for non-qualifying participants.

nodes.label: Age of Empires II: DE
nodes.description: Definitive Edition of the 1999 classic. Flagship title of Londinium. Empire Wars custom map pool.

nodes.label: Age of Empires IV
nodes.description: 2021 reboot by Relic Entertainment. Featured in Londinium with 4-player SE bracket.

nodes.label: The Last Chieftains
nodes.description: AoE2 DLC released Feb 17 2026. Introduced Mapuche, Muisca, Tupi + Inca rework. Reshuffled the tournament meta days before Londinium.

nodes.label: Yue Fei's Legacy
nodes.description: AoE4 DLC releasing May 19 2026. Introduces Jin Dynasty. Dominated discourse during Londinium as the looming meta disruption.

nodes.label: Naval Overhaul Patch
nodes.description: Free AoE2 patch concurrent with The Last Chieftains. Added Hulk-line anti-fire ships and Catapult Galleons. Disrupted water-map meta on Thames and Loch Ness.

nodes.label: Red Bull Gaming Sphere
nodes.description: Intimate esports facility in Shoreditch. Group stages Apr 1–3. Clinical, low-crowd environment — Hera noted no nerves.

nodes.label: Odeon Luxe Leicester Square
nodes.description: Luxury cinema. Playoffs & Semifinals Apr 4–5. ~700 attendees on massive theater screens.

nodes.label: Royal Albert Hall
nodes.description: Iconic South Kensington concert hall. Grand Final Apr 6. 3000+ fans. World's first live-orchestrated esports final.

nodes.label: Red Bull
nodes.description: Primary organizer and brand of the Wololo series. Provides venues, production, and commercial capital.

nodes.label: World's Edge
nodes.description: Xbox studio responsible for the Age of Empires franchise. Deep collaboration partner for Londinium.

nodes.label: AGON by AOC
nodes.description: Hardware sponsor providing high-performance competitive monitors for the event.

nodes.label: Hera
nodes.description: Canadian AoE2 player. Dominant Group A 1st seed (3-0). Reached Grand Final. Known for clinical, analytical play.

nodes.label: TheViper
nodes.description: Norwegian AoE2 GOAT. Failed standard qual, entered via emergency Replacement Qualifier. Won qualifier 2-0, then upset Liereyy in groups.

nodes.label: Mr_Yo
nodes.description: Chinese AoE2 strategist. Deployed Mapuche against Hera, built central walls on Loch Ness in tactical desperation play. Group A 3rd.

nodes.label: Hearttt
nodes.description: AoE2 player. Group A 2nd seed. Lost to Sebastian 4-3 in playoffs after APM degradation under pressure.

nodes.label: MbL
nodes.description: Norwegian veteran. Lost LCQ final to Vinchester, then eliminated in Group A. 0-2 in groups.

nodes.label: Liereyy
nodes.description: AoE2 mechanical prodigy. Group B 2nd seed. Lost to TheViper in a major upset; advanced to playoffs via strong record.

nodes.label: Sebastian
nodes.description: AoE2 player. Group B. Defeated Hearttt 4-3 in a grueling 7-game playoffs series showcasing superior stamina.

nodes.label: ACCM
nodes.description: Vietnamese AoE2 player. Heavily scripted build orders collapsed against custom map pool chaos. Eliminated Group B without a win.

nodes.label: Vinchester
nodes.description: Won LCQ tiebreaker over MbL for the final Londinium spot. Subsequently denied UK travel visa. Replaced by TheViper via emergency qualifier.

nodes.label: MarineLorD
nodes.description: French AoE4 juggernaut. Known for structurally perfect macro. Won 3-1 vs 1puppypaw to advance to Grand Final.

nodes.label: Wam01
nodes.description: Canadian AoE4 champion. Methodical, risk-averse macro style. Semi-finalist.

nodes.label: VortiX
nodes.description: Spanish AoE4 veteran. Aggressive, micro-intensive momentum style. Semi-finalist.

nodes.label: 1puppypaw
nodes.description: Canadian replacement for visa-denied Anotand. Unstudied wildcard with divergent civ preferences. Lost 3-1 to MarineLorD in SF.

nodes.label: Anotand
nodes.description: Belarusian AoE4 pro from Volda E-sport. Earned his Londinium spot via Road to Wololo, then denied UK travel visa weeks before the event.

nodes.label: Mapuche
nodes.description: New AoE2 civ from The Last Chieftains. Kona melee cavalry (damage bonus vs injured units) + Bolas Rider (slowing ranged cavalry). Chile/Argentina theme.

nodes.label: Muisca
nodes.description: New AoE2 civ. Guecha Warrior heals nearby allies on death. Temple Guard gains attack speed over time. Colombia theme. Attrition specialist.

nodes.label: Tupi
nodes.description: New AoE2 civ. Blackwood Archers train in pairs (double production). Ibirapema Warrior has frontal cleave AoE. Brazil theme. Swarm specialist.

nodes.label: Empire Wars
nodes.description: Red Bull Wololo's signature AoE2 format. Starts in Feudal Age with active economy — bypasses 5–8 min Dark Age. Forces immediate aggression.

nodes.label: Score Victory Controversy
nodes.description: Hera vs Mr_Yo Game 4. 75-min timer expired. Hera pivoted from combat to score manipulation (exploration, buildings, skirmishes). Won by algorithm, not conquest. Community divided.

nodes.label: Visa & Logistics Crisis
nodes.description: Two qualified players denied UK travel visas weeks before the event. Vinchester (AoE2 LCQ winner) and Anotand (AoE4 Road to Wololo finisher) both unable to enter the UK.

nodes.label: Live 40-Piece Orchestra
nodes.description: World's first live-orchestrated esports final. 40-piece orchestra performed AoE soundtrack dynamically in sync with live Grand Final gameplay at Royal Albert Hall.

nodes.label: T90Official
nodes.description: AoE2 casting veteran. Part of the Londinium AoE2 broadcast team alongside Nili, MembTV, and Dave.

nodes.label: Riley Knight (RLYKNGHT)
nodes.description: AoE4 broadcast host. Bridges technical gameplay with mainstream narrative accessibility. Anchored the AoE4 desk at Londinium.
